function.description: Safety-check an EVM token before trading it: detects honeypots and fee-on-transfer (tax) tokens via KyberSwap. Pass the chain and the token contract `tokenAddress` (resolve it with token_find first). The former key `address` is retired and is rejected by name. Read-only.
function.name: token_check

chain.description: EVM chain slug or alias (ethereum, base, arbitrum, …). Accepts a chain slug/alias or the numeric chain id token_find returns (e.g. base or 8453).

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address to inspect (0x… on the named chain). Resolve it with token_find first — a symbol is not accepted. The former key `address` is retired and is rejected by name.
